verdict.rationale: Hugging Face's own docs describe Inference Providers as a drop-in replacement for the OpenAI chat completions API. They say you just swap the base URL and point an existing client at it with a single Hugging Face token, which covers both the base-URL and API-key parts of the story. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that OpenAI SDK clients work unmodified, the exact base URL value or a code snippet in the evidence, and documented compatibility beyond chat completions (e.g. embeddings or other endpoints).

support.subject: As a developer, I can point an existing OpenAI SDK client at the provider by changing only the base URL and API key

citations.quote: Drop-in replacement for the OpenAI chat completions API.
Just swap-out the base URL to instantly access hundreds of additional open-weights models through our provider network.
Point it at Inference Providers to run [the latest open models available](https://huggingface.co/models?inference_provider=all) with a single Hugging Face token.
